label: The disappearance of Silver Blaze and the murder of John Straker
quote: the singular disappearance of the favourite for the Wessex Cup, and the tragic murder of its trainer
note: Undated so far; before the telegrams of Tuesday evening, which ask Holmes to help with the case.

label: Tuesday evening: telegrams from Ross and Gregory
quote: On Tuesday evening I received telegrams

label: Wednesday: Holmes broods and waits for news
quote: From hour to hour yesterday I expected to hear that he had been found
note: Also the 'whole day' of ¶4, when Holmes paces the room and the papers are sent up.

label: The arrest of Fitzroy Simpson
quote: beyond the arrest of young Fitzroy Simpson nothing had been done
note: Known to Holmes by Thursday morning; not otherwise dated.

label: Watson reads the Telegraph and the Chronicle on the case
quote: I have seen what the _Telegraph_ and the _Chronicle_ have to say
note: Some time before the train journey; not otherwise dated.

label: Thursday morning, at breakfast in Baker Street
quote: as we sat down together to our breakfast one morning
note: The day is given in ¶13: 'this is Thursday morning'.

label: Thursday, leaving Paddington by train
quote: the bundle of fresh papers which he had procured at Paddington

label: Thursday, on the train, Reading far behind
quote: We had left Reading far behind us

label: Thursday, on the train beyond Reading: Holmes times the train and states the case
quote: Our rate at present is fifty-three and a half miles an hour
